articles.title: Guardians learn start times for first two ALDS games at Progressive Field
articles.description: Cleveland will host Game 1 of the ALDS on Oct. 5 at 1 p.m. and Game 2 on Oct. 5 at 5 p.m., both on TBS, with their opponent determined by the Astros-White Sox wild card series.

articles.title: Parker Messick to start for Guardians in ALDS opener vs White Sox
articles.description: Rookie left-hander Parker Messick will start Game 1 of the ALDS for Cleveland, with Gavin Williams set for Game 2 against the Chicago White Sox.

articles.title: How Steven Kwan’s ‘ego death’ helped him rediscover his swing, and his place atop the Guardians lineup
articles.description: After a difficult first half, Steven Kwan revived his season by abandoning a pull-heavy approach and embracing a smaller role, ultimately leading the AL in second-half batting average.

articles.title: The Guardians earned their ALDS bye week, now they have to make sure it doesn’t cost them
articles.description: Cleveland has navigated this first-round waiting game before — and 2024's bye-week blueprint, which ended in an ALCS berth, could be the template for another deep October run.

articles.title: Guardians vs. White Sox: ALDS instant scouting report
articles.description: The Guardians and White Sox, familiar AL Central rivals, meet in the ALDS with Cleveland relying on José Ramírez, Jo Adell, and Parker Messick to counter Chicago's power and pitching depth.

articles.title: Guardians, White Sox set for first-ever playoff meeting after Chicago eliminates Houston
articles.description: The Guardians will face the Chicago White Sox in the ALDS after Chicago swept Houston in the Wild Card Series behind Chase Meidroth’s home run.

articles.title: Guardians’ potential playoff opponents set as Astros win AL West, will host White Sox in wild card round
articles.description: The Guardians, holding the No. 2 seed and a first-round bye, await the winner of the Astros-White Sox Wild Card Series to determine their ALDS opponent starting Saturday at Progressive Field.

articles.title: ‘It feels like home’: Jo Adell celebrates first postseason trip with Guardians
articles.description: After parts of seven seasons without reaching the playoffs, Jo Adell finally got his champagne celebration as the Guardians clinched a postseason spot at Fenway Park.

articles.title: Chase DeLauter, 4 Guardians pitchers nominated for 2026 All-MLB Team
articles.description: Five Guardians players, including rookie Chase DeLauter and pitchers Parker Messick, Gavin Williams, Foster Griffin, and Cade Smith, earned nominations for the 2026 All-MLB Team.

articles.title: Austin Hedges says Guardians’ AL Central title was worth the grind: ‘We’re not done’
articles.description: The Guardians clinched their fourth AL Central title in five years, and Austin Hedges says Cleveland’s difficult road made the celebration even sweeter.
